notes:
Summary: Product team (billing & support) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for chat-based billing agents with streaming + tool calling. Primary goal: reduce time-to-resolution for subscription issues (Stripe/Zuora) and automate invoice reconciliation. Interested in structured JSON outputs to feed downstream billing workflows.

Recent convo highlights:
- 2026-02-04 discovery call: Intro to Redwood runtime, focus on latency SLOs (p99 target 150-250ms when streaming). They asked about streaming tokens and partial-output reliability.
- 2026-02-18 demo: Hosted streaming demo with tool-calling flow to Stripe sandbox. Product team liked deterministic JSON schema output for refund/split-charge ops. SE demo recording -> ff_20260302_01.
- 2026-03-02 follow-up: Discussed Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Questions on autoscaling, burst capacity, and per-route costs. Asked for a sample Dedicated pricing worksheet.
- 2026-03-10 technical deep-dive with platform engs: Verified Zuora connector requirements (webhook auth, retry semantics). They provided sample Zuora webhook payloads; Redwood SE to map tool-calling -> structured JSON. Action: Luis to ship mapping template and POC plan.

Technical requirements / constraints (customer-specified):
- Workload: high-concurrency support-agent chat + synchronous tool call to Stripe/Zuora.
- Latency: streaming p99 <= 250ms desirable; p95 <= 120ms. Cold-starts acceptable for non-real-time flows but not for agent UI.
- Output: Strict JSON schema (invoice_id, action, confidence_score, recommended_payload) for automation. Must be validated by their QA harness.
- Models: Prefer open models for cost predictability; willing to evaluate Redwood-verified Llama/FP16 quantized variants. Also interested in fallbacks to smaller models for cost-sensitive routes.
- Ops: Need token-level cost breakdown, per-route tracing, and audit trails for every tool call.
- Security: SOC2 compliance mandatory, SSO/SAML for engineers, KMS for key control, retention policy 90 days (initial), EU data residency possibility for EMEA customers.

Commercial / POC notes:
- They want hosted POC first (2 weeks) to validate latency and JSON output quality. If POC passes, procurement will evaluate Dedicated pricing (committed capacity) for production.
- Estimated ARR band discussed: $75k-$200k (depends on committed capacity). Procurement timeline aimed for May 2026.

Direct quotes / paraphrases: "We need the JSON to be machine-perfect — any parsing errors break our billing pipeline." — Elena Park.

Next immediate actions: Luis to provision hosted POC sandbox, connect Stripe sandbox + Zuora webhook, provide mapping template and golden JSON schema by 2026-03-16. AE (Avery) to share Dedicated pricing worksheet and draft commercial terms by 2026-03-20.
